page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening), one column of running text with brace diagrams inline; margin notes of the Scripture references are set in the text lines below each paragraph; a narrow fragment of the facing left page at the extreme left edge (not transcribed).

main_text.p: Ordinarij sunt qui ad ordinariam politeias administrationem sumpti sunt: Levitæ. Leuit.10.9.11. Num.35.1.8. Ios.21.1.40. Gen.29.7. Num.3.11.15.45. & 8.14.
Quare hic etiam munera simplicia primo : Postea composita dicenda. Deut.17.8.
main_text.l: Simplicia munera hic sunt præter communia prædicta, proprium munus.
main_text.p: Sacerdotes erant perpetua successionis linea ex Aaronis familia ad sacerdotium in Tabernaculo exercendum sumpti. Exod.28.1.& 29.44.Num.25.13. & 18.1.7.

Pars autem muneris propria Sacerdotibus, erat vt imponentes manus filijs Israelis, & nomen Dei inuocantes : in eo populum benedicerent, post cultum Tabernaculi, benedictione quæ præscripta est.Num.6.22.ad 27.
Hac successione personarum, differentia a vero & æterno sacerdotio ἀπαραβάτῳ docebatur. Heb.7. 23.24.25.
Consecratio est personarum quæ omni carebat corporis

page.notes: The brace diagrams are rendered as outlines; the Greek word ἀπαραβάτῳ is as printed in the scan (uncertain form). Text at the left edge belongs to the facing page and is not transcribed. The last line of the page continues on the next page.
